name: run-console
title: Run Console
description: Follow compilation and execution, inspect output and stop a run.
useCases: During an exercise run, a student sees the execution phase, output and duration reported by the runner.
When a run stalls or fails, a student requests a stop or jumps to the offending line through the editor’s handler.
task: Follow compilation and execution, inspect output and stop a run.
behavior: For an external runner pass state with phase, output and duration in milliseconds. Wire cancellation to onStop and source navigation to onErrorLocation.
